subject.why: Brass storm lantern with glowing flame and red glass is clearly depicted on a crate.

category.why: The background features vertical wall slats instead of a plain, smooth gradient wall.

clean.why: No text, UI, watermarks, or characters present.

framing.why: The lantern is well-centered with ample breathing room on all sides.

colour.why: Vibrant, warm lantern tones contrast nicely against the rich purple backdrop.

detail.why: Features clean, simplified forms without noisy micro-textures or extraneous props.

style.why: Matches the reference cards with smooth, chunky 3D volumes and satin finishes.

fix: Replace the vertical paneling on the purple background with a seamless, smooth gradient.
